text: 国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，介绍2026年上半年工业和信息化发展情况。工业和信息化部新闻发言人、信息通信发展司司长谢存表示，下一步工信部将持续按照点、链、网、面、体系化工作思路，优化算力基础设施资源部署，打造算力互联互通节点，提升算力资源利用效率。在点上发力方面，将优化算力资源供给部署，统筹产业发展和能源供给等因素，推动智算集群建设和算电协同发展，打造梯次化算力布局，加强算力统筹监测。此外，将印发算力标准体系建设指南，推动建立算力服务能力评估、算力市场化定价等标准。
text_en: At a press conference by the State Council Information Office on industrial and information technology development in the first half of 2026, Xie Cun, spokesperson for MIIT and Director of the Information and Communications Development Department, said MIIT will optimize computing infrastructure resource deployment, create interconnected computing nodes, and improve computing resource utilization efficiency. This includes promoting intelligent computing cluster construction and computing-power coordination, and drafting guidelines for a computing power standard system, including assessments and market pricing standards.
